The <b>Crawbell</b> is an [[Items (Silksong)#Bellhome Upgrades|Item]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
Can be installed outside the [[Bellhome]]. Shell Shards and Rosaries appear in the Crawbell, which can be collected by interacting with the nest.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Bellhome.png!Bellhome location in Bellhart
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Crawbell 01.png!Crawbell installed outside the Bellhome
}}

== Mechanics ==
The Crawbell has a maximum capacity of {{R|300–500}} and {{S|300–500}}. The maximum capacity is randomly selected again every time the nest's contents are collected.

For every 5 minutes that pass in-game, {{R|5–20}} and {{S|5–20}} are added to the nest. The Crawbell is full after an average of 160 minutes of in-game time.

== How to Acquire == 
After beating the [[Greymoor#Court of Craws|Court of Craws]], the Crawbell can be collected in the room after the arena.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Court of Craws.png!Location of the Court of Craws
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Crawbell 02.png!Crawbell in the Court of Craws
}}

==Trivia==
* Squeaking craw sounds can be heard if the installed Crawbell is hit with the [[Needle]].
